g.text: parent_pack : string [ULID pattern; lineage only, sets no load order]
anti_pattern node with no file : refused after migration
one glossary context per file, terms inside
Composition (ADR-0048). built-in is a distribution pack:
it holds no artifacts and aggregates members through depends_on (d12).
A specialist pack only adds; a sibling conflict is refused (d9).
Level rule: pack_level may not exceed the parent's (d7).
Level of our own opt-in packs (java, qa, ...):
A sibling conflict is settled by the distribution pack's
own overrides edge, naming the winner.
Yellow «pending» / [pending …]: decided in the cited ADR,
but the cited open question is not ruled.
